instruction:
Using the official Federal Register API response, inspect documents matching artificial intelligence with publication dates from 2026-08-03 through 2026-09-02, ordered newest first. Report the first three results with title, every listed agency, document type, and publication date.

Stopping condition: Stop after the first three API results and all requested fields have been recorded in returned order.

Constraints:
- Do not use the CAPTCHA-protected Federal Register search interface.
- Do not open document links or submit comments.
- Use only the top-level results array returned by this exact official API query.
- Preserve multiple agencies and the returned result order.
